[C] FloatingBox variants
|-- FloatingPane: persisted in DisplayState.nodes
|   |-- Shared DisplayNodeBase
|   |   |-- id, childIds, expansion
|   |   |-- position {x,y}, bounds {width,height}
|   |   |-- coordinateSpace: canvas | viewport; pixels
|   |   |-- geometryPolicy: automatic/manual + content/fixed
|   |   `-- expandedGeometry? restores expanded allocation
|   |-- selection: SelectionRegion
|   |   |-- sourceBoxId, sourceContentId, sourceAscii
|   |   |-- sourceRevisionId?, rect, selectedIds
|   |   `-- displayMode: stacked/chained; activeChildId?
|   |-- projection: ProjectedPane
|   |   |-- title, projectionId?, source/targetRevisionId?
|   |   |-- activeChildId?
|   |   `-- content: call-tree | compaction
|   |       `-- OR source-code | code-panel
|   |-- conversation: ConversationPane
|   |   |-- thread, draft, canvasAnchor
|   |   `-- presentation: compact | floating | docked
|   `-- detail: DetailPane -> title, ascii, sectionId?
|-- arrow: FloatingBoxArrow
|   `-- derived from document.edges; absent from DisplayState
|-- add/removeDisplayNode -> ownership tree + active child
|-- setExpansion / updateDisplayGeometry / measureDisplayNode
`-- SelectionState owns membership separately
    `-- selection panes retain captured panel context
